query: What minimum baseline sample size and DCE design will reliably detect meaningful attribute utility differences and latent-class segments?

response.query: What minimum baseline sample size and DCE design will reliably detect meaningful attribute utility differences and latent-class segments?
response.answer: A minimum baseline sample size of 300-500 respondents and a well-structured discrete choice experiment (DCE) design can reliably detect meaningful attribute utility differences and latent-class segments. Larger sample sizes improve precision.
